observations: Two game controllers are shown: one blue with red accents on the analog sticks and D-pad, the other dark blue with standard PlayStation buttons.
The controllers are placed on a black surface with a PlayStation logo visible in the center.
The background is a wooden table with a green artificial grass surface below.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 style, not the 'fat' model mentioned in the seller's text.
The seller claims the PS4 is 'fat' and 'hacked with FC26 and 8 other games', but no visual evidence of the 'fat' design or the FC26 interface is visible.
The controllers show no signs of damage or wear in the photo.

claims.claim: PS4 fat hacked with FC26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The controller is not a 'fat' model as claimed; it is a standard DualShock 4.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the controller showing the 'fat' design (bulging analog sticks and D-pad) or a photo of the console itself.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard DualShock 4 controller, not a 'fat' model.

risks.risk: The controller is not hacked or does not support FC26 or the 8 games.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the controller connected to a PS4 console, with the FC26 interface visible or a screenshot of the game library.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-hacked, non-FC26 controller with no games included.

risks.risk: The controller is damaged or has internal issues (e.g., unresponsive buttons, stick drift).
risks.proof: A video showing the controller being used with a PS4 console, demonstrating all buttons and analog sticks working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or with reduced value due to unverified functionality.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the controller showing the 'fat' design.
A video or photo of the controller connected to a PS4 console, showing the FC26 interface or game library.
A photo or video of the console itself, if available, to confirm it is a PS4.
A video demonstrating the controller's functionality with all buttons and analog sticks working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
